labels.description: Self-applied labels, e.g. for adult content.

thread.description: The tech.tokimeki.forum.thread this comment belongs to (required when the channel kind is forum). The cid pins the version of the thread the author saw.

channel.description: Space record URI of the tech.tokimeki.forum.channel this message belongs to. A channel is a mutable container, so it is referenced by URI alone.

replyTo.description: The tech.tokimeki.forum.message being replied to (inline reply in chat, parent comment in forum). The cid pins the version replied to; the message may be edited afterwards.

editedAt.description: Set when the message was edited in place (putRecord with the same rkey).

main.description: A message posted into a chat channel, or a comment inside a forum thread. Always written into the author's own repo within the space.
